verdict.rationale: Fellow is a SaaS meeting-notes platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The evidence documents only a REST Developer API, webhooks, a ReadMe 'Try It!' panel and an MCP server. None of these is an official command-line tool: they are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
